BiblicalUsage: Phagos is a glutton, and it appears only on the lips of Jesus' enemies. They call Him a man gluttonous and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners, because He eats with the outcasts.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the charge tells me more about the accusers than about Jesus: they could not fault His teaching, so they faulted His table.
